_comment: aplayermode.com Pinterest daily drip queue (owner-approved 16 Oct 2026). config.pins_per_day is THE release rate. The Worker (workers/aplayermode-com/src/pinqueue.js buildPinfeedXml) serves /pinfeed.xml from this file at request time: the 5 launch items plus every variant whose release_date <= today in America/Chicago, newest config.max_feed_items; no deploy per day. channel + launch are derived from config/aplayermode_pinfeed.json; variants come from config/aplayermode_pin_angles.json via scripts/aplayermode/pin_queue.mjs (weekly: .github/workflows/aplayermode-pinterest-drip.yml). Guarded by validate:aplayermode-pinterest and tests/aplayermode/pinqueue.test.mjs.

channel.title: A Player Mode
channel.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team: it builds your plan, has it ready every morning and shrinks bad days, so your brain stops holding everything. Daily and weekly planning help for planners and ADHD-routine seekers.

launch.title: Daily Planner App That Plans Your Day for You: Founding 100 at $9.99/month
launch.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team. Answer easy taps for about 3 minutes and it builds your plan, then has it ready every morning: one priority, a short start, then the day. The first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at $9.99/month for as long as they stay subscribed. No free trial; cancel any time.

launch.title: Weekly Planning Without Overplanning: A Working Plan in About 3 Minutes
launch.description: Stop designing planners you never use. Tap through easy questions, about 3 minutes to a working plan, no essays. A Player Mode builds your one priority, your minimum day, your rules and your first 7 days, and you approve each piece. Then every morning the plan arrives on its own: one priority, a short start, then the day.

launch.title: ADHD Morning Routine Help: Max 5 Physical Steps, Then the One Task That Matters
launch.description: When starting is the hard part, a plan you have to build yourself is one more task. A Player Mode has your morning order ready at the time you set: feet to the floor, 1 minute of breathing, a glass of water, then your highest-leverage step. Bad days shrink automatically: no catch-up, no guilt. A planning app, not medical advice or treatment.

launch.title: ADHD Routine for Bad Days: A Minimum Day With No Catch-Up and No Guilt
launch.description: Routines break the day you miss one. In A Player Mode, Recovery mode gives you a minimum day after a bad day or in a low season: no catch-up, no guilt. Executive Review organizes the 3 to 7 things already in your head without adding new ones, and Deep Work protects one focus block. One tap, no paragraphs about how you feel. A planning app, not medical advice.

launch.title: Weekly Planner for Mind, Body and Spirit Goals, Covered Without You Deciding
launch.description: Planning work, workouts, sleep, faith and family by hand every week is a job in itself. A Player Mode starts every plan with Mind, Body and Spirit on by default and sorts anything else you care about into one of the three. It picks the workout, protects your sleep and makes room for family and faith, at a safe pace, without you guarding the time.

variants.headline: Room for faith, family and gratitude.

variants.headline: Missed yesterday? Get a minimum day.

variants.title: Missed a Day of Your Routine? A Planner That Gives You a Minimum Day, Not Catch-Up

variants.headline: Keep the agenda on what moves the needle.
